programmes.t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Giant Power Station, Smallest Aircraft"
programmes.d: How do they make giant floating power stations that provide power around the world? Plus, how do they fabricate the world's smallest aircraft?

programmes.t: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Concrete to Clay"
programmes.d: Innovators reimagine building materials using textile-reinforced concrete, ancient Roman techniques, and 3D-printed clay structures.

programmes.t: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Wood to Bamboo"
programmes.d: Architects harness rapidly renewable resources like timber, transparent wood, bamboo, and mycelium fungi to construct future cities.

programmes.t: Miracle Materials S1 - "Living Bridges And Fiber Constructions"
programmes.d: Hybrid architecture integrates living trees and resource-efficient fiber designs to cool urban centers and transform modern building.

programmes.t: Future From Above S1 - "Energy"
programmes.d: Pioneers explore solutions to power our planet, from massive renewables and grid redesigns to clean energy and ecosystem restoration.

programmes.t: Future From Above S1 - "Food and Water"
programmes.d: Vertical farming, ancient agricultural wisdom, and ocean desalination offer sustainable paths to secure food and water for the future.

programmes.t: Future From Above S1 - "Transport"
programmes.d: Innovators revolutionize travel through robotaxis, carbon-neutral aviation, drone highways, and clean fuels to reduce global emissions.

programmes.t: Future From Above S1 - "The Human Habitat"
programmes.d: Smart cities, carbon capture technology, and rewilding efforts help redesign human living spaces to restore harmony with nature.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "The Furnaces of Life"
programmes.d: Volcanoes discovered on alien worlds across space reveal active geology and potential environments for extraterrestrial life.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "The Winds of Creation"
programmes.d: Monstrous megastorms and chaotic weather across distant planets could spark the conditions needed for alien life to flourish.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "Planets from Hell"
programmes.d: Astronomers explore extreme exoplanets outside our solar system, uncovering terrifying cosmic environments.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "Cosmic Firestorms"
programmes.d: Powerful solar flares and cosmic magnetic storms pose a threat to surrounding worlds across the universe.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "Clockwork and Creation"
programmes.d: Planetary orbits range from chaotic destruction to cosmic forces that help shape the structure of the universe.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "Frozen Wanderers"
programmes.d: A icy comet transforms as it journeys through the solar system, shedding light on the origin of cosmic bodies.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "The Worlds That Never Were"
programmes.d: Water-rich asteroids and metal space rocks shaped planetary history and hold clues to the origin of life.

programmes.t: How the Universe Works S2 - "Birth of the Earth"
programmes.d: Cataclysmic cosmic blasts shaped Earth's formation, raising questions about whether similar worlds exist elsewhere.

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crayons, Mirrors"
programmes.d: How do they create coloured crayons used by children and artists around the world? Plus, how do artisans and craftsmen create treasured mirrors in India?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Electric Race Cars, Mead"
programmes.d: How do they power the next generation of race cars that run on electricity? Plus, how do they make mead - the favourite drink of the infamous Vikings?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Steam-Powered Boat, Waterwall"
programmes.d: How do they build the famous steam-powered paddleboats that cruise the Mississippi River? How did they create the powerful defence system called 'the waterwall'?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Paving Stones, Tuxedo"
programmes.d: How do they make modern paving stones and how has the process changed over thousands of years? Plus, how do they create a traditionally tailored tuxedo suit?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Fire Gloves, Enamel"
programmes.d: How do they fabricate fire gloves for emergency services personnel? Plus, how do they create the enamel that is used in bake-wear around the world?

programmes.t: Python Hunters S1 - "The Perfect Storm"
programmes.d: The Python Hunters decide to tackle the debate over how the Burmese Pythons came to be established in the Everglades.

programmes.t: Python Hunters S1 - "Dying to Survive"
programmes.d: A cold snap has hit the state of Florida and frigid temperatures are killing thousands of native and non-indigenous animals of all species. Has Mother Nature solved their python problem?

programmes.t: Python Hunters S1 - "Everglades Under Siege"
programmes.d: The Florida Everglades are home to thousands of invasive plant, insect and animal species and yet the Burmese Python is perceived as the biggest concern. Are they a problem or is this snake hysteria?

programmes.t: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Galapagos Shark"
programmes.d: Follow the team as they risk their lives to transport the shark 10 miles off shore for release in a protected marine reserve.

programmes.t: Ocean Vet S1 - "Eagle Rays"
programmes.d: Teaming up with international scientist Dr Matt Ajemian and eagle ray wrangler Chris Flook the team face a tricky task to capture one of the most intelligent fish in the ocean in some of Bermudas most beautiful surroundings.

programmes.t: Ocean Vet S1 - "Tiger Taggers"
programmes.d: Follow the team as they struggle to catch and tag the biggest tiger shark they’ve ever encountered as they complete their mission to help study, save and protect this incredible shark species.

programmes.t: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Mighty Marlin"
programmes.d: Watch as Neil and the Ocean Vet team wrestle a monster blue marlin to the side of the boat to attach a satellite tag that will expand the scientific knowledge of this species by revealing its oceanic migrations.

programmes.t: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Bermuda Turtle Project"
programmes.d: Follow the team as they capture and release wild green sea turtles in a bid to study their health and populations before fitting a satellite tag to a mature specimen that will collect vital data on it’s oceanic migrations.

programmes.t: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Sixgill Shark"
programmes.d: Watch Neil and Choy bring the shark to the side of the boat and work in testing conditions to remove dozens of hooks, cut steel lines and attach a tracking tag before Neil swims this massive shark back to the deep ocean.

programmes.t: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Bermuda Black Grouper"
programmes.d: Neil combines his veterinary knowledge and dive skills to assist the Bermuda department of fisheries on a exciting and dangerous mission to protect the breeding grounds of the Bermuda black grouper.
